sn41.6:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kāmabhū macchikāsaṇḍe viharati ambāṭakavane.
sn41.6:1.2: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā kāmabhū …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ etadavoca:
sn41.6:1.6: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati āyasmato kāmabhussa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi.
sn41.6:1.7: katamo pana bhante kāyasaṅkhāro? katamo vacīsaṅkhāro? katamo cittasaṅkhāroti?
sn41.6:1.8: assāsapassāsā kho gahapati kāyasaṅkhāro, vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāroti.
sn41.6:2.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:2.2: kasmā pana bhante assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro? kasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro? kasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāroti?
sn41.6:2.3: assāsapassāsā kho gahapati kāyikā. ete dhammā kāyapaṭibaddhā, tasmā assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro.
sn41.6:2.4: pubbe kho gahapati vitakketvā vicāretvā pacchā vācaṃ bhindati, tasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro.
sn41.6:2.5: saññā ca vedanā ca cetasikā. ete dhammā cittapaṭibaddhā, tasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāroti.
sn41.6:3.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:3.3: na kho gahapati saññāvedayita nirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
sn41.6:3.4: “ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjissanti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ti,
sn41.6:3.5: atha khvassa pubbeva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃtaṃ tathattāya upanetīti.
sn41.6:4.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:4.2: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa pana bhante bhikkhuno katame dhammā paṭhamaṃ nirujjhanti yadi vā kāyasaṅkhāro yadi vā vacīsaṅkhāro yadi vā cittasaṅkhāro? ti.
sn41.6:4.3: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa kho gahapati bhikkhuno vacīsaṅkhāro paṭhamaṃ nirujjhati, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato cittasaṅkhāroti.
sn41.6:5.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:5.2: yoyaṃ bhante mato kālakato, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno, imesaṃ kiṃ nānākaraṇanti?
sn41.6:5.3: yvāyaṃ gahapati mato kālakato, tassa kāyasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, vacīsaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho cittasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, āyu parikkhīṇaṃ usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni viparibhinnāni.
sn41.6:5.4: yo ca khvāyaṃ gahapati bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno, tassapi kāyasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, vacīsaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, cittasaṅkhāro niruddho paṭippassaddho, āyu aparikkhīṇaṃ, usmā avupasantā, indriyāni vippasannāni.
sn41.6:5.5: yvāyaṃ gahapati, mato kālakato, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno, idaṃ nesaṃ nānākaraṇanti.
sn41.6:6.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:6.2: kathaṃ pana bhante saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ hotīti.
sn41.6:6.3: na kho gahapati saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
sn41.6:6.4: “ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahissanti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahāmīti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhito vā” ti.
sn41.6:6.5: atha khvassa pubbeva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tathattāya upanetīti.
sn41.6:7.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:7.2: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa pana bhante bhikkhuno katame dhammā paṭhamaṃ uppajjanti, yadi vā kāyasaṅkhāro yadi vā vacīsaṅkhāro yadi vā cittasaṅkhāroti?
sn41.6:7.3: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa kho gahapati, bhikkhuno cittasaṅkhāro paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato vacīsaṅkhāroti.
sn41.6:8.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:8.2: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ pana bhante bhikkhuṃ kati phassā phusantīti?
sn41.6:8.3: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ kho gahapati bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti
sn41.6:8.4: suññato phasso animitto phasso appaṇihito phassoti.
sn41.6:9.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati …pe… uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:9.2: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa pana bhante bhikkhuno kiṃ ninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti kiṃ ponaṃ kiṃ pabbhāranti?
sn41.6:9.3: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho gahapati bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāranti.
sn41.6:10.1: sādhu bhanteti kho citto gahapati āyasmato kāmabhussa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi:
sn41.6:10.2: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā pana bhante kati dhammā bahukārāti.
sn41.6:10.3: addhā kho tvaṃ gahapati yaṃ paṭhamaṃ pucchitabbaṃ taṃ pacchā pucchasi.
sn41.6:10.5: saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā kho gahapati dve dhammā bahūpakārā
